title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for S_n must be correctly derived and presented as S_n = 2πBe(n + 1/2)/hbar c.

title: Use of A
description: Important Criteria: The substitution of P with p - eA/c must be correctly applied in the context of the Bohr-Sommerfeld relation.

title: Stokes' Theorem
description: Important Criteria: The application of Stokes' theorem to relate the magnetic flux φ to the vector potential A must be correctly shown.

title: Equation of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The classical equation of motion for the electron in a magnetic field must be correctly stated and used to relate p and r.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the derivation of the quantization condition must be avoided.
